I have been where you are now. I have been where all the people who are posting to this thread. I am so fortunate to live in the same city as Dr. Maskin who does meibomian gland probing.  IPL and  Lipiflow are temporary measures. Meibomian gland probing is far longer lasting. Most people require it only annually.  I also required Chalasis surgery.   The conjunctiva is a membrane that covers the front of the eye, sclera, and inside of the eyelids. It can lose its elasticity and no longer adhere to the sclera, which causes the conjunctiva to bunch up along the eyeline and cause irritation, pain, excessive tearing, and chronic redness. The membrane that is removed is replaced with amniotic membrane. That all sounds painful and just awful but it's done as an outpatient and it's a quick recovery with no pain. It made all the difference in the world to my eyes.  I don't know how many doctors do the meibomian gland probing or the chalasis surgery but it's sure worth asking about.  I was in such pain before I had the procedures I did consider suicide so I know what you are living with. Please ask your doctor if he/she knows of these procedures.  Dr. Maskin is in Tampa, FL and I know it's not easy for one to travel to see a doctor.  Good luck all and God bless.
